discovery_source.role: generate fixed history-specific predictions; no thresholds or predictions changed after validation execution

endpoint: far-minus-near terminal-minus-initial inherited-investment change; history prediction averages the three starts and demographic repeats

primary_validation.statistic: Pearson correlation across 128 histories between fixed discovery history means and new four-repeat validation history means
primary_validation.inference: 1999 paired visitor-history bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 1032026
strong_success_rule: 95% paired-bootstrap interval for large_plant_capacity minus natural correlation is entirely > 0
95% paired-bootstrap interval for visitor_pooled minus natural correlation is entirely < 0
primary_validation.weak_success_rule: observed ordering holds but one or both paired-bootstrap intervals include zero; retain as partial validation only
primary_validation.failure_rule: observed ordering fails; demote opposite-history-repeatability headline

secondary_validation: mixed-sign history counts across three starts after averaging four validation repeats, epsilon 0 and 0.01
validation-only history structured and demographic residual variance with four repeats
terminal occupancy for every validation arm
stopping: run exactly seeds 201-204; no seed extension, replacement, threshold tuning or outcome-based stopping
claim_boundary: This validates a prediction generated by a post-hoc discovery analysis; it does not make the original discovery preregistered.
The 128 visitor histories are synthetic environmental histories, not natural island replicates.
Capacity scaling and visitor pooling remain biological interventions, not pure statistical manipulations.
No natural variance component, natural prevalence or natural evolutionary rate is inferred.
